pkgmetadata.longdescription: The classic (pre-oneAPI) Intel C/C++ Compiler. These are the last icc generations able to target the Intel Xeon Phi: 17.0 is the final classic icc that can produce native Knights Corner (k1om) code with -mmic, and both 15.0 and 17.0 target Knights Landing with -xMIC-AVX512. Intel has retired these products, so the source tarballs must be supplied manually to DISTDIR, and a valid classic Intel license is required at runtime.
